verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI is an AI-oriented crawling and extraction tool, so a configurable effort level for autonomous data gathering is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence shows no documented low/medium/high reasoning-effort setting. Adaptive crawling that decides when to stop and the `--max-pages` limit on deep crawls are related controls, not a selectable reasoning-effort level, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can set how much reasoning effort an autonomous agent spends on a data-gathering task (low, medium, high)
